description: A stage-breakdown bar chart for Power BI — split a total duration into up to three named stages per row, so you can see not just how long something took but where the time actually went. Codex Time Breakdown answers the question a stacked bar leaves open. A stacked bar gives you the total; this gives you the mix — every stage named, its value on the bar, and the total called out at the end of the row, with rows ordered by a measure you control. New in v2: a categorical segment ramp with LED-style gaps, an optional Dead Time Segment that greys out non-productive stages, background transparency, and title and value text that adapts to dark report canvases. Conditional formatting (fx) is available on the three segment colours, the total colour, and the category label colour — drive them from a measure or a rule. IDEAL FOR Field service and dispatch — dispatch, travel, and on-site time per scenario Process cycle time where queueing, transit, and handling need separating SLA and response breakdowns where the stage mix matters more than the total Before-and-after process improvement comparisons Any additive measure that decomposes into named stages KEY FEATURES Up to three named stage segments per row, each with its own colour and label Total measure rendered as an end-of-row label Dead Time Segment — render one chosen stage muted grey to mark idle or waiting time Optional delta…
